items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution, with no new spend, monetization changes, deployments, requeues, experiments, or telemetry. Continue only the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation. Revenue support is limited to $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21, from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; all $4.92 is unattributed to sites. AI usage cost is $901.90 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 4,926 calls, but contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because revenue is not site-attributed or period-matched and infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, and experiment costs plus budget ceilings are missing. Do not treat clicks, orders, shipped items, sessions, conversions, AI calls, output counts, or pilot throughput as financial performance. Minimum evidence required: matching-period site/content revenue by registered attribution ID; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs; approved budget ceilings; and a predefined cost-to-learn threshold. Preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed and retain existing finance reconciliation only.

Retain existing work item 67ebb985-a7b8-47f4-9792-b4d727275c4a only. Reconcile the 2026-09-21 aggregate commission against matching-period attributed revenue and all recorded AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs. Record budget ceilings and the cost-to-learn threshold when evidenced. Escalate only after the minimum evidence is attached; do not create duplicate finance work or infer margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, or causal lift.
